title: What Moves? Localized Motion Representations for Compositional Scene Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.04383v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world dynamics are inherently compositional: multiple entities move simultaneously within a shared scene, each exhibiting distinct motion patterns. Yet most existing video representations encode motion globally, without explicitly capturing localized motion for individual entities. Crucially, motion is defined relative to a global reference frame, including camera motion and scene layout. However, localized embeddings are often computed from cropped images or obtained by masking features after encoding, discarding the context needed to interpret motion. To address this, we introduce a promptable localized motion representation that produces persistent embeddings for user-specified regions defined by spatial masks. Rather than cropping the input or masking features, our model processes the full video and conditions motion encoding directly on the queried region. translated_title: 什么在运动？用于组合式场景控制的局部化运动表示
translated_abstract: 现实世界的动态本质上是组合性的：多个实体在共享场景中同时运动，每个实体表现出不同的运动模式。然而，大多数现有的视频表示以全局方式编码运动，没有显式地捕捉单个实体的局部化运动。至关重要的是，运动是相对于全局参考系定义的，包括相机运动和场景布局。然而，局部化嵌入通常是从裁剪后的图像中计算得到的，或者在编码之后通过对特征进行掩码处理获得，这丢弃了解释运动所需的上下文信息。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种可提示的局部化运动表示，它能够为由空间掩码定义的用户指定区域生成持久的嵌入。我们的模型不是裁剪输入或对特征进行掩码处理，而是处理完整的视频，并直接以查询区域为条件对运动进行编码。这产生了时间上一致的、可按区域寻址的嵌入。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可提示的局部化运动表示方法，通过在完整视频上直接以用户指定的空间掩码区域为条件进行运动编码，生成时间一致、可按区域寻址的持久嵌入，从而解决了现有视频表示无法显式捕捉单个实体局部运动的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a promptable localized motion representation that processes the full video while conditioning motion encoding directly on user-specified spatial mask regions, yielding temporally consistent and region-addressable persistent embeddings to capture per-entity motion for compositional scene control.
